expected.subject: Tom, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Tom,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for Corporate used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

As Partner, Corporate/M&A, you're probably still spending too much time coordinating associates through repetitive contract drafting and review across transactions.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in seeing a brief demo?

William
Legora

notes: Hengeler Mueller Corporate/M&A Partner, 330 lawyers, Germany. Senior title → SMB+ → demo soft question.
